title: Colorado man freed after 27 years for infant's murder seeks $2m, but family calls claim a joke
summary_full: Stephen Martinez has filed a $1.9 million claim for state compensation following his wrongful imprisonment of 27 years, a conviction now overturned. However, the family of the baby involved contests this request, deeming it inappropriate under the current circumstances. Under Colorado law, Martinez must demonstrate actual innocence to qualify for state compensation, and a judge will decide if he meets this necessary legal standard in a forthcoming ruling.
